energy.title: PLN bill
energy.noSites: No energy site yet. Set up the site with its PLN tariff, then add the meter on PLN's supply.
energy.noSitesReadOnly: No energy site is set up yet. Ask an administrator to add one.
energy.unconfirmedTitle: To be confirmed with your PLN bill.
energy.unconfirmedBody: The excess-kVArh rule (kVArh above tan(acos 0.85) × kWh), the WBP hours and K are common practice, not yet checked against this site's contract. Enter one month of PLN's figures below; this note goes away when a month agrees within 2%.
energy.excluded: Energy charges only: demand charge (biaya beban), PPJ and VAT (PPN) are not included, as in the PLN bill worksheet.
energy.noIncomer: No enabled PLN incomer meter: add one under Setup.
energy.noData: No metered data for this month yet.
energy.noKvarh: no kVArh tag on the meter
energy.dailyTitle: Daily WBP premium and kVArh charge
energy.qualityLegend: Hours per day: ok / estimated (interpolated across a gap or a counter reset) / gap (data missing).
energy.dailyKvarhNote: PLN bills excess kVArh per month; the daily figure is each day's own excess and shows which days cause it.
energy.reconcileDeleteConfirm: Delete PLN's figures for this month?
energy.reconcileRequired: kWh LWBP, kWh WBP and kVArh are required.
energy.reconcileHelp: Copy the figures from PLN's bill. Rupiah lines are optional; without a total, PLN's quantities are priced with this site's tariff. Leave out demand charge, PPJ and PPN.
energy.reconcileNone: PLN's figures for this month have not been entered.
energy.reconcileAfterMonth: Enter PLN's figures when the bill for this month arrives.
energy.reconcileWithin: The totals agree within 2%: the setup is confirmed.
energy.reconcileOutside: The totals differ by more than 2%: check the tariff, K, WBP hours, meter multiplier and the kVArh rule.
energy.wbpHint: Local time, whole hours, e.g. 18:00-22:00 (comma for several). Check your contract.
energy.contractedKvaHint: For reference; the demand charge is not computed.
energy.validFromHint: A tariff applies from the start of its billing month. Same month replaces it.
energy.kHint: From the bill: 1.4 to 2 for I-3.
energy.kvarhFactorHint: Blank: tan(acos(limit)) = {{v}}. To be confirmed on a real bill.
energy.wbpKwTargetHint: Alarm when a WBP hour averages more. Blank: off.
energy.dailySummary: Send yesterday's kVArh charge and WBP premium once a day
energy.noMeters: No meter yet. Add the meter on PLN's supply as a PLN incomer.
energy.deleteMeterConfirm: Delete meter {{name}} and its computed hours?
energy.kvarhTagHint: Cumulative reactive energy, if the meter has it.
energy.kvarTagHint: Integrated over time when there is no kVArh counter.
energy.multiplierHint: CT ratio × PT ratio × unit (0.001 for Wh counters).
energy.rolloverHint: Raw value the counter wraps at, e.g. 4294967296 for 32 bits. Blank: none.
energy.meterBackfill: After saving, hours are computed from the start of last month in the background.
energy.notificationsHelp: Alarms appear in the alarm list. To get them, or the daily summary, by Telegram, WhatsApp, email or webhook, add a notification rule with one of these source keys:
energy.keyPf: rolling power factor below the warning level
energy.keyDaily: daily summary of yesterday's kVArh charge and WBP premium
energy.deleteSiteConfirm: Delete {{name}} with its tariffs, meters, hours and PLN figures?
